headline: Manufacturing Sector Projected Acceleration
insight_text: Manufacturing is projected to grow 4.2% next year driven by regional industrial zone expansion and food processing demand.

headline: Agricultural Output Climate Vulnerability
insight_text: Agriculture production may experience temporary yield declines due to El Niño climate conditions affecting quarterly crop harvests in Zamboanga del Norte and Sibugay.

headline: Infrastructure Construction Momentum
insight_text: Construction contributes approximately 16.3% of projected regional GDP in 2026, driven by national infrastructure connectivity projects across Region IX.

headline: Inflation Rate Stabilization
insight_text: Regional inflation rate is projected to stabilize around 4.2% in 2026 (95% CI: 2.4% - 6.0%), easing consumer cost pressures.
